changelog: - The board explains its card badges (#3977): "What do the badges mean?" in the board header opens a small panel (`BoardLegend`, open state remembered per browser) with a miniature of each badge — days in the stage (grey), past the stage's deadline (red, exclamation mark), the follow-up day and, on the sales board, the trial end. The follow-up and trial chips carry the same sentence as their hover text.

en: The board now explains its badges: open "What do the badges mean?" above the columns to see what the day counts, the red warning and the follow-up date stand for.
tr: Pano artık simgelerini açıklıyor: sütunların üstündeki "Simgeler ne demek?" ile gün sayılarının, kırmızı uyarının ve takip tarihinin ne anlama geldiğini görebilirsin.
de: Das Board erklärt jetzt seine Symbole: Über „Was bedeuten die Symbole?“ oberhalb der Spalten sehen Sie, wofür die Tageszahlen, die rote Warnung und das Wiedervorlagedatum stehen.
